image_pattern_summary: Verified good images show complete timber/log home exteriors photographed from a front-facing or three-quarter angle, with the full structure visible including roof, walls, windows, and veranda/deck. Settings are natural outdoor environments (pine forests, green lawns, open countryside), which reinforce the eco-tourism and hill-station positioning of the product. One good image shows a high-quality interior with timber-panelled walls and ceiling, demonstrating the finished living space quality.

reason: Log home images are architectural exterior/interior photographs — the visual appearance of the structure (timber cladding, roof style, veranda, setting) IS the product information buyers evaluate.
No meaningful text is printed on the product itself; OCR would extract only incidental watermarks or branding overlays, not product specifications.
